name: What is the difference between baseboards, crown molding, and chair rails?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between baseboards, crown molding, and chair rails?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baseboards are installed at the bottom of walls where they meet the floor, protecting the wall and providing a finished look. Crown molding is installed at the top where walls meet the ceiling, adding decorative flair and visual height. Chair rails are typically installed horizontally about one-third of the way up a wall, originally to protect walls from chairs but now primarily for decorative purposes. Each type serves a distinct aesthetic and functional role, contributing to the overall architectural detail of a room. Hometelligent Inc. can assist in designing a cohesive trim plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Baseboards finish walls at the floor, crown molding decorates wall-to-ceiling transitions, and chair rails are decorative horizontal strips on walls. Each serves a distinct aesthetic purpose.
